bounties.title: Listen to Voice Clips and Label Emotions
bounties.description:
Take part in a listening study that takes about 45 minutes. Listen to English voice clips and choose the emotion and speaking-style labels that best describe each voice.

Please use headphones or work somewhere quiet, listen to every clip fully, and answer carefully.

You will receive $10 for completing the study, plus a $0.50 attention bonus if your labels match our expert labels, for careful completion and following the labeling instructions. Two practice rounds with expert feedback will show you how the task works.

After finishing the study, you must return to this task page, upload the completion code as evidence, and mark the task as complete. Both steps are required so we can review your submission and issue payment.
requirements: Comfortable understanding spoken English
Use headphones or a quiet environment
Complete the study only once
Listen fully and answer honestly
Desktop or laptop recommended
After finishing, upload the completion code as evidence and mark the task as complete on this platform
bounties.completionCriteria: Complete the entire listening study, follow the audio and labeling instructions, upload the unique completion code shown on the final screen as evidence on this task page, and mark the task as complete. One completed submission per participant.
bounties.evidenceCriteria: Upload the unique completion code displayed on the study's final screen as evidence on this task page and mark the task as complete.

bounties.title: Listen to English recordings and identify their meaning
bounties.description:
Help us study how tone of voice changes the meaning of a sentence.

You will listen to 150 short recordings. For each recording, choose the interpretation that best matches how the speaker says it. 

The task takes approximately 30 minutes and includes two optional breaks and three attention checks. You will NOT need to record your voice.
requirements: Be at least 18 years old.
Be a native English speaker.
Use a laptop or desktop with a reliable internet connection.
Use headphones in a quiet environment.
Complete the task yourself, without AI tools or assistance.

lifecycleMessages.onAccepted:
Hi! Thanks for accepting this bounty. You have been approved for the task. You have 5 HOURS to complete the study using this link:

https://human-validation-production.up.railway.app

You will need a desktop or laptop, working speakers or headphones, and a quiet room. Once you finish, the website will give you a completion code beginning with RAH. Please send me that code here so I can confirm your submission.

Thank you!
lifecycleMessages.onRejected: Thank you for your interest. Unfortunately, we will not be proceeding with you at this time.

bounties.completionCriteria: Listen to and assess all recordings, then submit the unique `rah_` completion code displayed after the experiment confirms that all your responses have been saved.

bounties.title: Make and hold a large Vorflux sign at SF Caltrain — afternoon
bounties.description:
We need one person to create and hold a large handwritten Vorflux promotional sign near 4th & King, 700 4th Street, San Francisco for the full scheduled shift.

Before the shift, buy real rigid brown corrugated cardboard and make a vertical sign approximately 36 inches wide by 48 inches tall. Use thick handwritten marker lettering and strongly contrasting colors. The sign must be readable from across the road. Send a clear photo for approval before traveling to the location.

Write this main message exactly:
ENGINEERING AGENTS
THAT MANAGE
YOUR ENGINEERING AGENTS

At the bottom, write exactly:
POST A PHOTO OF ME HOLDING THIS SIGN
TAG @VORFLUXAI ON X
GET $100 IN VORFLUX CREDITS

Hourly compensation is set in the listing. We will additionally reimburse sign creation and materials after you submit the receipt and approved sign photo.

We will also send an additional bonus for each qualifying public X image. The hired human must appear clearly in the image holding or standing with the sign, the sign must be readable, the post must tag @VorfluxAI, and you must provide the public post link. Private, duplicate, deleted, or unverifiable posts do not qualify.

Stay on the public sidewalk. Do not enter the road, block pedestrians, traffic, crosswalks, or entrances, or claim affiliation with nearby venues. You may politely invite interested people to photograph the sign, but do not pressure anyone.

Paid reasonable breaks are allowed. Take one 10-minute break about every two hours and one 30-minute meal break on shifts longer than five hours.
requirements: Attend the full scheduled shift.
Create a vertical 36 by 48 inch handwritten brown corrugated cardboard sign.
Send the completed sign photo for approval before traveling.
Remain on the sidewalk and follow all local laws and venue rules.

Your shift:
- Tue Oct 13, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM PT

You collect a foam-mounted sign (18x24 in, vertical) from a FedEx Office location in San Francisco.

Once you confirm your spot, RentAHuman posts the sign artwork and your FedEx Office pickup details in the bounty chat: the store name and address, the order name to give at the counter, and when it is ready.

Collecting the sign pays a flat sign delivery fee on top of your street hours, already included in your pay.

After your last shift (Tue Oct 13, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM PT) you recycle the sign responsibly. There is no drop-off.

bounties.title: Dialogue editor: read all the lines in a small cozy game and flag what sounds stiff (about 4 hours, native English)
bounties.description:
Kal's Valley is a small, gentle walking game in a web browser: you help a valley of neighbours get their solar drones flying again. It has about 720 lines of dialogue (around 8,000 words) across 17 characters.

We want one careful reader to go through every line on a review web page we've built and tell us which lines sound stiff, generic, written rather than spoken, out of character, or too much like another character. For those, mark "flag" with a short reason, or "suggest" and write the line the way you'd have it, keeping that character's voice.

The page groups lines by character, shows each conversation together with who's speaking to whom, and has a short note on each character (who they are, how they talk). You mark each line fine / flag / suggest. Your answers save as you go, so you can do it in several sittings.

Things that are on purpose (please don't flag): all game text is lowercase; the valley is vegetarian; words from other languages (bà nội, peddatata, odi, teta, abuela...) are deliberate.

At the end you fill in three short notes: which characters sound too alike, the three biggest problems with the writing, and anything else.

We care about honest, specific notes far more than speed. A line you flag with a clear reason is worth more than ten lines marked fine.

Writing sample (in your application): rewrite this line so it sounds like a tired gardener actually said it: "the soil remembers every season we have given it."
requirements: Native or near-native English, with a good ear for how people actually talk
Comfortable reading on a laptop or desktop browser
About 4 hours, can be split over a day or two
bounties.completionCriteria: Every line on the review page answered (all ~720, about 8,000 words; the page shows your count), with a reason on each flag and a rewritten line on each suggestion, and the three overall notes filled in. Then press "done" on the page.
bounties.evidenceCriteria: Text: the line "you covered N lines (W words)" from the page, copied exactly, plus your three biggest problems in a few sentences. Photo: a screenshot of the page's count after pressing done.

applicationDetails.label: Your rewrite of the gardener line from the description
Any writing or editing you've done (fiction, games, scripts, subtitles)? A link or a sentence is fine.
